Rina (Design): Quick sync on the batch embeddings preview + rerank heatmap. Main asks: color contrast on heatmap, export CSV delimiter for locale, and modal focus traps on small screens. Sharing wire: https://figma.com/ourfile :mag:

Sam K (Frontend): Heatmap currently uses a blue->purple gradient. Contrast tests show low delta at middle values. We should bump saturation or add pattern overlays for better distinction for low-vision users.

Liam (A11y): Pattern overlays are good. Also add a numeric score tooltip and aria-label for each cell: "Row 7, score 0.78, rank 3". Ensure these are keyboard reachable via arrow keys inside the table.

Priya (Product): On CSVs: our EU customers reported Excel opening CSV with semicolon delimiter depending on locale. Can we support exporting as TSV or letting user pick delimiter in modal? Maybe default to comma but detect locale?

Noah (Data): Backend can emit `delimiter=auto` where we set semicolon if locale in Accept-Language includes `de,fr,es` etc. But front-end should show a checkbox: "Use semicolon for Excel locales" or explicitly "Export as TSV".

Sam K (Frontend): Implementation plan: export modal adds radio: [Comma (CSV)] [Semicolon (CSV - Excel)] [Tab (TSV)]. Default = Comma, with small help text: "Choose semicolon for some Excel locales". We'll need API param `delimiter`.

Rina (Design): Nice. Copy for help text: "If your spreadsheet opens columns together, try semicolon or TSV." Short and plain.

Liam (A11y): Modal focus trap: on mobile the modal currently takes full screen but doesn't restore focus to triggering button after close. Must call focus() back to the toolbar primary. Also ensure Escape closes it and focuses last interactive element.

Sam K (Frontend): Noted. We'll wire proper focus return and add `aria-modal=true`. Also change toolbar so it's a single composite widget to reduce tab stops.

Priya (Product): Re: heatmap legend: can we add both color legend and textual buckets (High/Medium/Low) so non-color readers can parse quickly?

Rina (Design): Yes. Legend will show color swatches + labels + numeric thresholds (e.g., >=0.85 high). Also add a toggle "Show bucket labels" in view options.

Noah (Data): When exporting with buckets, include extra columns: `score` and `bucket_label`. Keep `raw_similarity` too. CSV header example: id,query,match,score,bucket_label,model.

Liam (A11y): For keyboard users navigating the heatmap, arrow keys should move between cells, Enter opens the detailed preview, and screen reader should announce "cell 2 of 10, score 0.5, low relevance". We should add role=grid and proper aria-row/aria-col indices.

Sam K (Frontend): Adding role=grid and aria attributes. Might be slightly heavy on DOM; we'll lazy-render tooltips.

Rina (Design): UX nit: when a user toggles bucket labels off, we still show numeric tooltip on hover/focus. Also put a persistent label above table saying which embedding set + model is active.

Priya (Product): Approve copy: Persistent label = "Embedding set: Customer-QA (text-embed-v1.2)".

deploy-bot: Scheduled front-end canary deploy for branch heatmap-accessibility on Friday 09:00 UTC.

Rina (Design): Action items: Sam to add delimiter options + focus fixes, Liam to produce aria strings and sample sr-only helper text, Noah to confirm CSV header order, Priya to approve final copy, Rina to update figma. Reconvene after canary. :+1:"
